mechanism: Sulfasalazine contains an azo bond metabolized by gut bacteria to produce sulfapyridine, which can inhibit monoamine oxidase activity; combined with tranylcypromine (irreversible MAOI) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis.
action: Avoid this combination; if necessary, use alternative antirheumatic agent and monitor closely for hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, rigidity, hyperthermia), and maintain strict dietary tyramine restrictions.
